answer: A sparrow account that spins up many fake identities would need to post and lock stake for each, paying full cost per sybil, while honest peers in the meadow verify attestations. Each agent stakes collateral and must solve a per-epoch challenge seeded by a public beacon, binding reputation slot to real work. Copying another's proof fails because the beacon seed changes every round, so forgery costs compound faster than any reward a farm could harvest. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
